2609.08572.title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
2609.08572.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks and reduces wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ on average compared to the next-fastest baseline.
2609.08572.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）為基礎的多代理系統（MAS）通過使用專門的多個代理來實現強大的性能，但其性能依賴於每個代理的提示設計。<lb/>在MAS提示優化中，使用自然語言反饋指導提示更新的文本梯度方法已成為一種主要範式。<lb/>在本文中，我們確定了現有文本梯度方法在兩個階段的限制：梯度提取和梯度聚合。<lb/>在梯度提取中，以前的研究在未驗證修改目標提示是否能解決失敗的情況下選擇目標提示，並在沒有對應代理的中間輸出進行代理級監督的情況下推導梯度。<lb/>在梯度聚合中，個別梯度被隨機分組和串接，通常混合不相關的失敗模式，並生成無法泛化的提示。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了\textbf{AgentGrad}，這是一個基於序列干預和語義文本梯度抽象的多代理系統提示優化框架。<lb/>對於每個失敗，序列干預一次修改一個代理的行為，以識別修改能解決失敗的目標代理。<lb/>目標代理的修改輸出隨後作為提取細粒度梯度的代理級監督。<lb/>語義文本梯度抽象將語義相似的梯度聚類，以防止混合不相關的失敗模式，並將每個聚類抽象為捕捉共享修正模式的通用梯度。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，AgentGrad在五個MAS基準上實現了最先進的性能，並將牆鐘優化時間平均減少了$2.5\times$，相比於下一個最快的基準。
